stem.text: Which statement explains why DNA replication is described as semi-conservative?

A.text: Half of each original strand is conserved in each new molecule of DNA.

B.text: Half of the base sequence of each strand is conserved in each new molecule of DNA.

C.text: Only one strand of DNA is used as a template during replication.

D.text: The template for each new molecule of DNA is one strand of the original molecule.
